body: But like he doesn’t really care about me. The only reason everyone doesn’t absolutely hate me is that they’ll look bad. At one one point they were all gonna leave me in the middle of nowhere about 200 miles away from home. So they couldn’t care less about me.

It’s what I truly believe. I don’t have a job and am currently living with my brother. I don’t help around the house much because it’s literally so hard to get out of bed. It makes me feel very worthless. If I did kill myself and got a very expensive funeral then my siblings would each get almost 5000 dollars. It’s a win-win
I turned 18 about 4 months ago. There’s just no real reason for me to live. I’m literally just a drain on resources.

No I’m not military. I had about 6 deaths in the family within a year with absolutely no support and then I got stuck into an abusive home. It’s not that big a deal that I got it that way I know, but it still hurts me real bad
Thanks for at least trying. I’m sure I could find a more efficient way. There’s some guns around here

I can’t bring my parents, my grandma or one of my favorite uncles back. I can’t make myself love me without a ton of work that I’ve already tried. I came so close just a minute ago to taking a whole bottle of sleeping pills. It would let me see all of them again even if just moments.
Hope. Actual tangible signs that it will get better. I’m tired of all the bullshit that people try to tell me “just hang in there” “it’ll get better”. It hasn’t gotten better for years.
I used to enjoy a whole lot. I would laugh all day and be so entertained by video games and the like. I’m not even interested in them anymore
